The Amitsur-coherent Čech witness exists (ζ2·i, the (C1) étale-separatedness campaign): any witness cochain θ₀ for ζ1's class equality q₁*N = q₂*N over Spec(B ⊗[A] B) is corrected by a single global unit into an Amitsur-coherent one. The defect of θ₀ glues to a global unit of the triple tensor (exists_glued_defect); the comparison p₂^♯θ₀ · (u₂^♯α / u₁^♯α) against the upstairs witness of the lift glues on the curve product and descends through the projection to the correcting unit χ (exists_comparison_unit, via the abstract two-relation ratio compatibility unitsAppLE_coboundary_ratio_compat); the glued defect is the Amitsur coboundary of χ, checked after p₃-pullback where the upstairs telescope cancels exactly (glued_defect_eq_amitsur_coboundary); and θ₀/χ is the coherent witness (CoherentCechWitness structure + nonempty_of_defect_eq_coboundary, headline Over.exists_coherentCechWitness). Proof terms engineered for kernel replay: opaque cover/cochain definitions (amitsurCover, comparisonCover, defectCochain, comparisonCochain, stepGCover) and an abstract-schemes pullback calculus (UnitsGlobalPullback) reduce every concrete step to a single application — the monolithic ancestor died in kernel deterministic timeouts.
